changeSet.author: nexus-r7xao
changeSet.comment: Read-only: counts and RAISE NOTICEs how many nexus.tuples rows already have body over 4096 UTF-8 bytes, before tuples-003-2 deletes them. Toggles FORCE RLS off on nexus.tuples for the duration of the count (nexus_admin is the owner with no BYPASSRLS) and restores it. No DML anywhere in this changeset.

changeSet.author: nexus-r7xao
changeSet.comment: Cleanup migration (warn and delete; tuples are short-lived coordination rows): delete every nexus.tuples row whose body already exceeds 4096 UTF-8 bytes (tuples-003-1 logged the count), before chk_tuples_body_size is added below. tuple_claim_log_tuple_fk's ON DELETE SET NULL (tuples-001-2) nulls the referencing claim-log rows the same way the sweep's own purge does -- no extra statement needed. Toggles FORCE RLS off on both nexus.tuples and nexus.tuple_claim_log for the duration (nexus_admin is the owner with no BYPASSRLS, and the DELETE's cascade writes to both tables), restoring it before the changeset ends. Flat, splitStatements="true" statements (catalog-013-1b's exact shape), not a DO block: tests/test_changelog_rls_lint.py's FORCE-RLS DML tripwire does not recognise a toggle nested inside a procedural block as guarding the DML inside it. DATA EFFECT: DELETEs every nexus.tuples row whose body exceeds 4096 UTF-8 bytes (tuples-003-1 logged the count first); irreversible — a body this old and this large would already have expired under its own template's retention_seconds regardless (documented no-op rollback below).

changeSet.author: nexus-r7xao
changeSet.comment: chk_tuples_body_size: nexus.tuples.body capped at 4096 UTF-8 bytes (TupleLimits.MAX_BODY_BYTES) -- the DB-level backstop behind TupleRepository's own engine-side check. Added NOT VALID (metadata-only, no table scan) because tuples-003-2 already removed every violator; tuples-003-4 validates it immediately after.

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.tuples DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_tuples_body_size;

changeSet.author: nexus-r7xao

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'chk_tuples_body_size'

changeSet.comment: VALIDATE chk_tuples_body_size -- expected to succeed on every install, since tuples-003-2 already removed every violating row. SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE only (no write block); DDL, never row-filtered by RLS (catalog-013's own precedent), so no toggle is needed here. Guarded (nexus-4m6i0/nexus-ms57z crash-loop class, fk-002-7's shape): a whole-changeset precondition naming this constraint marks the changeset ran, once, instead of hard-failing on any box where tuples-003-3 has not yet added it (e.g. this changeset applied out of the normal changelog order, or a future rollback of tuples-003-3 alone).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.tuples VALIDATE CONSTRAINT chk_tuples_body_size;
